independent_elementary_inverse: For odd p>2, if its unit group has no generator, primitive-root count is0 and cannot match the positive answer.
If it has a generator, its primitive-root count is phi(phi(p)).
For composite p, phi(p)<p-1; therefore its primitive-root count is strictly less than(p-1)/2=2^(m-1).
The supplied count therefore forces p prime. For prime p=2^m+1, phi(p-1)=phi(2^m)=2^(m-1) verifies the reconstruction.
